adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i`, then applies them directly: `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)`. The diff shows no clamping/validation, so a request like `?offset=-1` will produce a negative OFFSET (Postgres rejects this), causing a 500. Likewise, an arbitrarily large `limit` can be requested, defeating the intended pagination and potentially causing excessive load. This behavior is introduced/exposed by the new pagination API returning `meta` and accepting `limit/offset` for all groups (previously only automatic groups were paginated).
